checks: Demo renders curves and blocks correction export
Demo JSON retains its simulated-data flag
Quality-passing data requires acknowledgement and all four exports produce files
JSON import validates files without replacing a good report on error
Pairing verifies the build before allowing a measurement
Four modes, Standard default, estimates and separated target groups are available
A camera alone is not ready: locking sample positions is required, not perfect alignment
Lock immediately enables Run with fixed sample positions, without passing exposure checks first
Zero-frame failure retries twice then shows a paused error on BOTH devices, keeping the square visible
Realign and Resume finish all Quick patches; both devices receive the full report
Reports show omitted measurements and downgrade unconfirmed exposure instead of claiming calibrated accuracy
Lock never checks exposure, but severely clipped capture at Run pauses with a specific explanation
Manual square lock remains available when automatic marker detection cannot confirm alignment
Stop cancels the loop, retains progress and synchronises the stopped state
Disconnect interrupts capture without deleting the checkpoints on either device
Reconnection requires revalidation and resumes the remaining patches successfully
Four taps register the actual sample geometry without requiring guide overlap
Recoverable warnings show a specific reason and Continue anyway on phone, with monitor in review state
Continue anyway finishes all patches without repeating the warning, records consent on both devices and blocks correction export
Diagnostic reports retain downloadable raw CSV and JSON with accepted warnings
Fresh verification is separate from calibration, compares held-out tones and preserves the original JSON baseline
Optional monitor setup reflects selected controls and provides a visual light/dark pattern with Close enough
Sustained large marker movement pauses capture and retains completed readings
Stop from the warning dialog cancels cleanly rather than leaving an unresolved review
environment: Chromium DOM only; synthetic camera acquisition; in-memory transport
